9a

Light emitted by cooling helium gas is passed through a prism and observed on a screen.

9b

The wavelengths in the spectra correspond to photons with different energies that are emitted when an electron in the helium atom makes a transition from a higher to a lower energy level. Since there are only discrete wavelengths in the spectrum, the energy levels in the helium atom must also be discrete.

question.html:
The following diagram shows some of the principal lines in the visible emission spectrum of atomic helium. The wavelength for each line is shown below the diagram.

 

a. Explain how this spectrum can be produced in an experiment.

  [3]

b. Outline how the existence of discrete atomic energy levels in the helium atom can be deduced from this spectrum.

  [3]

c. The energy of a photon emitted in the helium spectrum is 2.1 eV. 

i. Calculate the frequency of this photon.

 [2]

ii. Circle the emission line on the diagram that represents the photons with this frequency.

  [1]

d. The results of new scientific experiments are often published in peer-reviewed scientific journals. Outline why this is common practice amongst scientists.
